payload_json.loop: Two-button cast sequence: (1) cast Bladefall to rain blades at target location, leaving lingering blades on the ground around enemies; (2) cast Blade Blast to detonate all lingering blades in a chain of explosions — each detonation can mark further blades, emptying the queue at up to 30 detonations per second. mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Physical->no family (crosswalk §1 physical rule); the blades deal physical hit-damage, element-neutral, identity via geometry+propagation. The IDENTITY MISS: the lingering-blade field is a FIELD RESOURCE you plant (Bladefall) then consume (Blade Blast) — econ_raw=field-resource-consume. Engine placed entities (placed_lane/totem) are autonomous colliders, not a detonation-queue whose every member is spent by a second skill. Mapped as multi_projectile-seed -> ring-detonation-cascade (GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade), which captures the plant-then-explode feel but LOSES 'the blade field is a spendable ammunition pool.' A BF/BB player would notice their two skills are no longer coupled by a shared consumable field-substrate — the blade-count-as-detonation-budget is what made the combo sing. Field-resource-consume docketed (shared family with animate-weapon's ground-item-as-ammo, batch-01). The 30-detonations/s empty-the-queue cadence is a magnitude the ring+propagation approximates. Profane Bloom cursed-death chaining routes as the GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade on-kill reading.

spine.mech_note: Bladefall volley lands blades into the ground as persistent objects (stagger count); Blade Blast detonates all accumulated lingering blades simultaneously for physical/chaos AoE damage scaled by number of blades present. The two-button sequence is PLANT → DETONATE: cast Bladefall once or twice to stack ground-blades on the target area, then Blade Blast to consume all blades in a chained explosion. Blade Blast damage scales with blade count — more pre-placed blades means larger detonation. Mine delivery (self-detonating mines) automates the Bladefall plant phase, making the player only press Detonate. Popular as a CI (Chaos Inoculation) occultist build where chaos damage bypass is irrelevant. Introduced in 3.9 (Metamorph) and has held varying viability across leagues since — strong at league start for solo self-found.
